'''Reha Logg'''<ref name="Depth" /> was a light-skinned and dark-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="aotc" /> considered a [[Clothing/Legends|fashion]] victim.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> During a [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Logg visited<ref name="aotc" /> the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> There, the Human<ref name="aotc" /> drank and talked with<ref name="Depth" /> the socialite<ref name="IA">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030512.html|series=Image Attack|text=Flirting in the Shadows}}</ref> [[Sel Maa]]<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> and stood next to the Human<ref name="aotc" /> [[Daro Willits]] in a private alcove.<ref name="IA" /> 

As the two conversed, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the club, searching for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Logg continued to stay with Maa and Willits as Skywalker searched around the club.<ref name="aotc" /> The club patron wore dark clothing, heels, and a large headpiece.<ref name="aotc" /> "Reha" was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] first name of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Reha Logg first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes featuring the character were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was revealed in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Logg was first identified in an Episode II Depth Commentary available on [[StarWars.com]] that could be accessed through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>
